qs.s: ___ est allé à l'école avec son petit frère ce matin.
qs.en: Gaspard went to school with his little brother this morning.

qs.en: In the forest, this large oak tree is more than two hundred years old.

qs.en: For this table, the craftsman chose solid oak rather than pine.
